pairs.difference: A: the pumpkins sit at about the same grey as the grass, so orange against green does most of the separating. The dark accents are thin, mostly the crevices and the shadow under the group. B: the topiary is a dark mass against a light band of sky, with a dark hedge and a cast shadow to its right. Its leaf flecks are busy, and its gap of -0.189 is just past the real range. B still has the clearer light, middle and dark plan.
pairs.fix: Make the pumpkins' lower sides fall into one broad deep shadow shape, with near-black gaps between them and a darker contact shadow on the grass, so they read darker than the lawn even in greyscale.

pairs.difference: B: the lion and plinth form one huge near-white shape with almost no shadow inside, set on dark foliage. Its gap of 0.211 is above the real range. A: the cooler is a mid-dark block with a light lid liner, a light cow badge, a dark shadow on the sand and steady middle bands behind it. Its vignette of 0.117 is slightly high.
pairs.fix: Shade the marble lion in soft grey: put a broad shadow down the far side of the body, under the mane and on the shaded face of the plinth, and keep pure white only for small highlights on the top planes.

pairs.difference: A: the bat is a nearly uniform dark shape on a one-level yellow field, with almost no middle step between them. Its gap of -0.407 is far outside the real range. B: the envelope and photos are a light mass on stepped mid and dark green rings, and the photo adds a dark inner group. Its gap of 0.139 is only slightly high.
pairs.fix: Lighten the bat's wings and body with broad lit purple planes on top and rim light along the wing edges, so the bat steps from mid purple to deep shadow instead of one dark silhouette.

pairs.difference: B: the cauldron is a huge black mass that takes much of the card, on a dark magenta wall and dim shelf, with a mean of 0.504 far below the real range. The only glow is a tight dome behind it. A: the shoes are mid-grey on a pale floor, with a hard two-band backdrop. Its mean of 0.762 is high, but only just.
pairs.fix: Brighten the whole card: use a lighter pink backdrop and shelf, and turn the cauldron's lit side into a broad mid-grey blue with shadow only on the lower third.

pairs.difference: B: the card is high-key and almost flat, with the backdrop at one grey level. The brass stem sits close to it, and the only real dark is the ellipse under the base. Its mean of 0.822 and contrast of 0.081 are both outside the real range. A: the dark green lamp has near-black accents against light rays, a white glow in the glass and a clear stepped ray pattern.
pairs.fix: Deepen the backdrop diamonds to a medium teal and shade the brass candelabra with dark brown shadow bands along the stem, arms and base underside, so the holder reads darker than the background.

pairs.difference: A: the door, frame and leaves share dark and middle levels, with light flecks scattered through the ivy and streaky value inside the door. Only the wreath separates, so there are no big groups. Its mean of 0.552 and vignette of -0.07 sit at the low edge of the real range. B: dark roofs, light windows and a mid sky form simple, stacked value groups.
pairs.fix: Keep the door one calm mid-blue value, make the ivy a darker, simpler frame with fewer bright leaves, and let the wreath be the only light shape near the centre.

pairs.difference: A: the stone sits at nearly the same grey as the pale sky stripes, and its lit left edge melts into them. The dark accents are thin, in the cross recess and under the grass. Its mean of 0.743 is above the real range and its contrast of 0.117 is below it. B: the slide's dark underside and pale tiles make strong large groups, though its contrast of 0.120 is at the floor of the range.
pairs.fix: Make the gravestone a darker warm grey than the sky, with a broad shadow down its right side and a deep dark inside the carved cross, and set the sky stripes to a clearly deeper blue.

pairs.difference: A: the sphere stays in the same middle levels as the wall, with only small highlights and a tight fuzzy halo hugging it. Its contrast of 0.092 is below the real range. B: the blue cabinet has a big dark side panel and bright framed glass on a mid wall. The hero separates clearly and the darkest areas are broad.
pairs.fix: Give the crystal ball a deep navy shadow crescent along its lower and outer edge and darken the metal stand's undersides. Replace the tight halo with a wider soft brightening of the wall.

pairs.difference: B: the broom bristles and floor share nearly the same light-middle value, with only a small dark patch under the bristles. The handle is barely separated from the wall. Its contrast of 0.08 is well below the real range. A: the red mower is a large dark mass with black tyres and a handle, on a wide light disc behind it. Its gap of -0.272 is slightly past the range.
pairs.fix: Add a deep shadow into the broom bristles and under the binding, darken the handle's shaded side, and paint a stronger dark cast shadow on the floor. Darken the wall so the broom stands clear of it.

pairs.difference: A: the coffin lid is one flat mid-dark plane and the side a slightly darker one, with streaky bands in the wood and floor and few steps inside the hero. B: the chair has a fuller run of values, from light cushion and slats through mid wood to dark rockers, on dark corner stripes with a glow behind. Its gap of 0.001 means hue does much of the separating. All numbers are in range for both cards.
pairs.fix: Shade the coffin lid with a broad gradual falloff from a lit corner to a dark far end, and add a brighter top edge band and a deep contact shadow on the floor.

pairs.difference: A: the pumpkin sits inside the same middle level as the backdrop, with no true black anywhere. There is one dark crescent and a bright face. Its contrast of 0.089 is near the bottom of the real range. B: the jacket has a dark sash, near-white badges and black cuff openings against a strong dark rim. Its vignette of 0.134 is a little too heavy.
pairs.fix: Add near-black accents in the carved cuts around the eyes and mouth and under the stem, and deepen the shadow side so the pumpkin stands darker and harder against the purple rays.

pairs.difference: A: the towel has speckled stipple over mid and light stripes and no dark mass, and the hero shares its level with the green backdrop. Its contrast of 0.076 is below the real range. Dark corners are the only low values. B: the coral has clear broad groups, with dark rocks anchoring the base and a large light disc behind. All its numbers are in range.
pairs.fix: Add a deep shadow under the towel and in its big folds, make the orange stripes much darker than the yellow ones, and remove the fine speckle so each stripe reads as one clean value.

pattern: Generated cards still lose on the value range inside the hero and on how simply the card groups. Most often they compress into the middle and light levels, with no broad dark form-shadow shape and only thin dark accents, so hue does the separating (towel, candelabra, broom, crystal ball). Others go to the opposite extreme, with a one-level silhouette or an unshaded white mass (bat, cauldron, lion). Real cards keep one large dark shadow mass on the hero, a small near-black accent at the contact point, and a wide stepped glow or background pattern. Generated cards tend to use a tight halo hugging the outline, and fine speckle or streaks that break up the groups. Caveat: every call rests on value evidence only. The odd cards I chose skew toward horror-themed subjects, but I did not use subject as evidence. p01, p06, p10 and p11 are weak calls at confidence 2.
